It added the {{Color|Other|Plushie}} [[Accelerator]] skin and a few minor changes. This version encompassed five updates, the main v1.8.5 Update (released 22 September 2023) and four minor updates, the v1.8.5a (released 22 September 2023), v1.8.5b (released 25 September 2023) v1.8.5c (released 6 October 2023) and v1.8.5d (released 6 October 2023). ==Additions== *New [[Codes|code]] obtained by purchasing a [[Accelerator Plush]] **Code is unique for each [[Accelerator Plush]] bought **Gives {{Color|Other|Plushie}} [[Accelerator]] skin ==Changes & Bugfixes== *VR is now supported in the lobby. *Skin back-end reworked. *Reworked chat. *Fixed [[Minigunner]] viewport using its attack animation instead of its idle animation in places like the inventory or tower hotbar. *Fixed {{Color|Pirate|Pirate}} '''Warden''' losing its torso when upgraded to Level 4. :In '''v1.8.5a''': *Fixed level barriers not disappearing in the Lobby when you met the level requiremenets. *Fixed [[Lay By]], [[Crystal Cave]] and [[The Heights]] using the old version of the map. *Fixed sprinting not working. *Fixed {{Color|Pirate|Pirate}} [[Crook Boss]] skin being removed from the game. *Fixed [[Accelerator]]'s beam not changing colors at Level 5. *Fixed fan art boards not working properly. *Fixed wind shaders. :In '''v1.8.5b''': *Fixed Unwavering Tides Bundle [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] not giving any skins. *Fixed Unwavering Tides Bundle [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] not appearing in the [[Gamepasses]] section of the store. *Fixed 🌆 Vigilante Skin Bundle ⚡ [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] having a cost of {{Robux|600}} and being on sale for 16% in the [[Gamepasses]] section of the store. *Fixed the [[v1.8.4|Unwavering Tides Update (v1.8.4)]] update log not appearing in news feed. *Fixed [[Black Spot Exchange]] and [[Stained Temple]] no longer being in the game. *Fixed the Scores tab in Rewards not working. :In '''v1.8.5c''': *Improved game performance. :In '''v1.8.5d''': *Fixed UI not working. ==Gallery== {{Gallery|Open = Yes| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}}
